name: Fearsome F Events at Carnegie Mellon 2026

venue.name: Jared L. Cohon University Center, Connan Room
venue.address: University Center, 5032 Forbes Ave, Pittsburgh, PA 15213
venue.details: The competition will be held in Connan Room of the Jared L. Cohon University Center (CUC).

information: **This competition does not have typical events and is not recommended for new competitors.** This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competitor Information tab. Due to limited space, a maximum of 1 spectator is allowed per competitor. ### **In the spirit of Halloween, we encourage everyone to wear a costume to this competition!** Please see the Halloween Costume Information tab for rules.
